scope: Author-side console retry and explicit verification cache correction

findings.issue: Replay scheduling generated a new UUID and tick payload on every button click after an uncertain network response.
findings.correction: ReplaySubmission retains the exact logical instruction until confirmed acceptance or a definite initial rejection. Later rejections cannot resolve an earlier uncertain attempt.
findings.evidence: Seven native UI-model tests including two new replay tests; WASM check/build passed. No browser behavior claimed.

findings.issue: A newly observed global Cargo build.build-dir redirected intermediates independently of explicit --target-dir.
findings.correction: Verification and WASM build helpers set CARGO_BUILD_BUILD_DIR for the child command to the requested target. User configuration and full-debug/incremental profiles remain unchanged.
findings.evidence: Local Rust1.99.0 Cargo primary docs read; scoped commands recorded their build_dir and succeeded.

limits: Pending replay identity lives only in the open page; it is not persisted across reloads.
Model tests do not exercise native browser network policy, DOM events, accessibility or visual layout.
The global mixed Cargo cache was not deleted, relocated or counted as course-only storage.

primary_source.note: Versioned web URL was unavailable through the web tool; read the installed1.99.0 documentation instead.

additional_primary_source.observation: Response::json passes awaited response text to serde_json::from_str; no JavaScript JSON.parse numeric conversion in that method.
